text: That is very interesting. <break time="0.8s" /> Said the policeman. <break time="0.8s" /> Have you heard from your friend. <break time="0.8s" /> Since then. <break time="0.8s" /> Well, we wrote to each other. <break time="0.8s" /> For a while but after a year or two. <break time="0.8s" /> We lost touch. <break time="0.8s" /> The West is a very big place. <break time="0.8s" /> And I was always moving around quickly. <break time="0.8s" /> But I know. <break time="0.8s" /> That Jimmy will meet me here. <break time="0.8s" /> If he is still alive. <break time="0.8s" /> He was always. <break time="0.8s" /> The truest, most loyal friend. <break time="0.8s" /> In the world. <break time="0.8s" /> And he will never forget. <break time="0.8s" /> The waiting man. <break time="0.8s" /> Took out a fine watch. <break time="0.8s" /> Whose lids were set with small diamonds. <break time="0.8s" /> It is three minutes to ten. <break time="0.8s" /> He said. <break time="0.8s" /> We parted here. <break time="0.8s" /> At ten oclock exactly. <break time="0.8s" /> I guess. <break time="0.8s" /> You did pretty well in the West. <break time="0.8s" /> Said the policeman. <break time="0.8s" /> I sure did I hope. <break time="0.8s" /> Jimmy has done half as well. <break time="0.8s" /> But he was a kind of plodder. <break time="0.8s" /> I had to fight. <break time="0.8s" /> Against the sharpest minds. <break time="0.8s" /> To get my money. <break time="0.8s" /> The policeman twirled his club. <break time="0.8s" /> And said. <break time="0.8s" /> Well, I will be on my way. <break time="0.8s" /> I hope your friend comes. <break time="0.8s" /> I will give him. <break time="0.8s" /> Half an hour at least. <break time="0.8s" /> Said the man. <break time="0.8s" /> And the policeman walked on.
